subtitle: Academic Presentation
courseType:

educationalGoal: In this subject you will acquire presentation skills in English. The learning goals are as follows (1) Learn the format and structure of the academic presentation. (2) Learn linguistic expressions used in presentations (eg, descriptions of figures, tables, graphs, data, etc.) (3) Learn how to create presentation materials and manuscripts.
advice: This course is a presentation skills course. We will cover the following materials: 1. English Presentation Basics 2. Structure and Flow of Academic English Presentation 3. Digital Presentation Students are required to actively participate in the class.
requiredKnowledge: Computer literacy skills such as presentation software It is recommended that prospective graduate students and Boeing Externship students take this course.
